title: Preparation and hydrogen storage capacity of templated and activated carbons nanocast from commercially available zeolitic imidazolate framework
material_description: BF-900 | ZIF-templated carbon: furfuryl alcohol infiltrated into Basolite Z1200 (ZIF-8, Sigma-Aldrich) template, polymerised 80 °C 24 h then 150 °C 6 h under Ar, carbonised at 900 °C for 8 h under Ar (3 °C min-1); template removed during carbonisation
source_location: main article PDF p.5 (journal p.150), Fig. 6a, series BF-900 (green down-triangles)
notes: archive: fig6a_BF-900.json. Marker count = markers resolved on the plot; markers below ca. 1.3 bar overlap and are not counted. T printed as -196 °C (77.15 K). wt% calculated by the authors 'on the basis of a density of 1.5 g cm-3 for the carbon samples and a density of 0.04 g cm-3 for the hydrogen'; uptake basis and buoyancy correction not named; no saturation reached up to 20 bar. BET range: P/Po 0.06–0.22. Total pore volume from N2 uptake at P/Po = 0.99; micropore volume method not stated; NLDFT pore-size maxima 8/15/20 Å printed (no single average diameter, field left empty). Degassed 200 °C and 10^-10 bar (printed; 1e-5 Pa) for 4–6 h (printed range, duration field left empty). H2 purity 99.9999% (printed). Residual mass at 1000 °C (TGA in air) ca. 11.5 wt%, attributed by the authors to incomplete removal of Zn (residual ZIF template); residual_metal_wt_pct left empty because the residual mass is not stated as Zn wt%.

source_location: main article PDF p.4 (journal p.149), Table 1, row BF-1100 (H2 uptake wt% and H2 uptake density columns); pressure 20 bar from text sect. 3.4 (journal p.150); plotted in Fig. 6a (journal p.150)
notes: no digitized point: the end marker of BF-1100 (black crosses) overlaps the BF-1000 red circles in Fig. 6a and could not be separated. Same measurement as the plotted end point of the BF-1100 isotherm (Fig. 6a); Table 1 H2 uptake printed 3.0 wt% at 20 bar (text: 'uptake at 20 bar is summarised in Table 1'). areal_uptake_g_cm2 = Table 1 'H2 uptake density' printed 14.1 µmol H2 m-2 x 2.01588e-10 g cm-2 per µmol m-2 (text and abstract print this unit as 'mmol', Table 1 header reads µmol, and area x density reproduces the wt% only for µmol). Marker count = markers resolved on the plot; markers below ca. 1.3 bar overlap and are not counted (BF-1100 crosses counted at p >= 10 bar from their tails beside the BF-1000 circles). T printed as -196 °C (77.15 K). wt% calculated by the authors 'on the basis of a density of 1.5 g cm-3 for the carbon samples and a density of 0.04 g cm-3 for the hydrogen'; uptake basis and buoyancy correction not named; no saturation reached up to 20 bar. BET range: P/Po 0.06–0.22. Total pore volume from N2 uptake at P/Po = 0.99; micropore volume method not stated; NLDFT pore-size maxima 8/15/20 Å printed (no single average diameter, field left empty). Degassed 200 °C and 10^-10 bar (printed; 1e-5 Pa) for 4–6 h (printed range, duration field left empty). H2 purity 99.9999% (printed). TGA residual mass ca. 2 wt% (stated for 1000, 1050 and 1100 °C samples; described as virtually ZIF/Zn free). Text p.148 area order for 1000/1100 °C samples is reversed relative to Table 1 (Table 1 used: BF-1100 = 1067 m2 g-1).

activation_method: KOH activation, carbon/KOH weight ratio 1:4, 700 °C for 1 h under N2 flow (3 °C min-1); washed three times with 2 M HCl then distilled water to neutral pH; dried 120 °C 3 h
source_location: main article PDF p.5 (journal p.150), Fig. 6b, series ACBF-1050 (blue squares)
notes: archive: fig6b_ACBF-1050.json. Marker count = markers resolved on the plot; markers below ca. 1.3 bar overlap and are not counted. T printed as -196 °C (77.15 K). wt% calculated by the authors 'on the basis of a density of 1.5 g cm-3 for the carbon samples and a density of 0.04 g cm-3 for the hydrogen'; uptake basis and buoyancy correction not named; no saturation reached up to 20 bar. BET range: P/Po 0.06–0.22. Total pore volume from N2 uptake at P/Po = 0.99; micropore volume method not stated; NLDFT pore-size maxima 8/13/21 Å printed (no single average diameter, field left empty). Degassed 200 °C and 10^-10 bar (printed; 1e-5 Pa) for 4–6 h (printed range, duration field left empty). H2 purity 99.9999% (printed). Fig. 6b end marker digitizes to ca. 3.76 wt% whereas Table 1 prints 3.9 wt% (3.5% lower).
